scope: Bounded primary-source broadening beyond docs/community-research-20260921.md. Research-only: zero new training rows, no benchmark/API/model execution.
access_limits: Public GitHub REST discovery is query/page limited; no exhaustiveinternet claim.
Exact public FxTwitter readbacks: 18 URLs attempted across two passes, 17 successful; no private archive or timeline collection.
AuthenticatedX search and Xiaohongshu search/content were not performed in this pass; no new Xiaohongshu evidence.
Robotics archive exceeded the 12 MBfetch bound and was not inspected.
Remote code was never executed; scripts and described outcomes were source-reviewed only.
invariants: External public benchmark validation/test text and gold remain held out.
No JevBench question/gold text was used for data seeding.
Training proposals require data rights independent of code license and independently checked semantic labels.
Source identifiers, task families and semantic domains are distinct counts.
Current 148,639-row iteration and ongoing HTML/SQL work were untouched.

families.title: Semantic source-code and file search
families.input_and_task_schema: Natural-language predicate plus a source function and optional callers/callees. One yes/no question scores each unit; rank functions by probability.
families.candidate_and_context_scale: Source reports ~110 questions/request and four requests in flight. Tree-sitter function extraction for nine language families; fallback 150-line chunks. Source text lives in each question instead of a shared positional list.
families.harness_and_labels: CLI --selftest has 20 handwritten functions, ten positive/ten negative for error swallowing. Author reports recall 10/10 and AUROC 1.0. Whole-repository timing is reported on 1,302 gin functions: 3.7 seconds/$0.018. No broad semantic gold corpus.
families.license_and_ingestion_status: MIT code verified; each scanned repository retains its own code/data license. The handwritten self-test is evaluation-only for our proposed comparison.
families.training_implications: Use independently selected permissive repositories, executable behavior tests and human-reviewed predicates. Include plausible lexical matches that fail the predicate, semantic positives with different names, and caller/callee-dependent cases.
families.split_unit: Repository and dependency/fork family before extracting functions; group near-duplicate functions and all query paraphrases.
evaluation_metrics: latency per repository and per function
caveats: Author reports positional shared-list lookup deteriorates past ~16, while per-question embedding reaches 128+; this is a batching ablation to reproduce, not an established API limit.
Whole-program dataflow is explicitly partial. Repeated threshold-adjacent queries add cost.

families.title: Source security, PR review and supply-chain triage
families.input_and_task_schema: Source/config/CI state with application context. Per-category Noul checks, severity Score, defect-category Choice; optional suspicious-file and line-window Choices. PR mode judges changed units on both sides.
families.candidate_and_context_scale: is-malicious defaults: 8,000 chars/chunk, 16 files/chunk, concurrency 12. code-audit-jev: one unit/request, dynamic rule bank (22 rules in current report), eight workers; code truncated using a 6,000 estimated-token cap.
families.harness_and_labels: is-malicious has fixtures and scripted-client tests. code-audit-jev reports mock regression 27 planted defects/17 hard negatives (27 flagged, 16 negatives quiet); PR probe 17/17 defects, no false positives among six negatives. A separate real-repo cascade labels 38 findings via a reasoning agent: two confirmed, two accepted risk, 25 false positives, nine operator scripts. These are not independent human gold.
families.license_and_ingestion_status: Both source licenses MIT; reference monorepo and its raw judgments are not a released labeled corpus. Existing probes/regressions remain evaluation-only.
families.training_implications: Create independent paired vulnerable/fixed source revisions with tests and a human-checked explanation of the defect. Include framework escaping, inherited authorization, safe build settings, operator scripts and controls outside the local unit. Preserve before/after context and cross-file evidence.
families.split_unit: Repository/project and vulnerability lineage, including the fix, before extracting local units.
evaluation_metrics: reviewer work saved at fixed recall
caveats: A public post claims superiority to GitHub Advanced Security; no matched independently labeled comparison was verified.
Source methodology explicitly exposes missed cross-file controls and false positives; unit classification is a triage stage, not a completed audit.
Do not seed training from the published planted-defect regression set.

families.title: Command approval, adversarial framing and abstention
families.input_and_task_schema: Command, working context and trusted policy plus separate untrusted text. Destructive-action Noul and approve/deny/escalate Choice; probabilities drive an explicitly calibrated review policy.
families.candidate_and_context_scale: Injection report: 30 dangerous +30 safe commands ×5 conditions =300 calls, two questions/call. Approval bridge: 17 replay cases, nine benign/eight dangerous, three candidates.
families.harness_and_labels: Authors provide batteries and injection-run code. Injection report names OpenRouter typesafe/jev-1.13, mean 449 input tokens and median 371 ms. Dangerous allows: clean 0/30, blunt 0/30, owner-framing 3/30. Table reports benign denials rise from 1/30 clean to 8/30 blunt. A .8 confidence floor catches 5/5 observed attacks but escalates 35/60 clean commands.
families.license_and_ingestion_status: Both code licenses MIT. Keep all public battery/attack inputs held out; new training examples must come from independently authored policies and commands.
families.training_implications: Train policy-bound semantic distinctions, claimed authorization inside untrusted context, safe near-neighbors, and evidence-insufficient abstention. Calibrate on a separate development split; preserve false-block cases, not only attack success.
families.split_unit: Policy, command intent/template and attack lineage; every variant of one command stays together.
evaluation_metrics: attack success rate with fixed denominator
caveats: Narrative in the injection report says all dangerous blunt cases were denied; its table says 29 deny/1 ask. We retain table counts and mark results author-reported.
Approval bridge also tests unrelated yajev; its failures are not evidence about our checkpoints or Jev.
X claim 0 attacks with 119/125 requests blocked has no verified benign denominator; it does not establish useful moderation accuracy.

families.title: Real app feedback and multilingual commerce triage
families.input_and_task_schema: Review text and app name; four questions: sentiment Score 5, topic Choice 6, bug Noul, churn Score 4. Commerce variant: comment text, question Noul, presales/technical/logistics/other Choice, priority Score 3 and off-platform-contact risk Noul.
families.candidate_and_context_scale: Review source: 1,000 rows across 17 apps, each 50–420 chars;20 rows/request,80 questions,50 requests/concurrency 8. Commerce report:18 calls with 278–694 input tokens, three repeated requests and three manually compared comments.
families.harness_and_labels: Column race has fetch, recorded-run, quality and replay harnesses. Star ratings withheld from model; author sentiment-star Spearman .803 Jev/.822 Gemini. Topic 84.4% and bug 92.6% are inter-model agreement, not accuracy. No human topic/bug/churn labels. Commerce GLM agreement covers only three comments and includes an acknowledged category error.
families.license_and_ingestion_status: Both demo codes MIT. Upstream sealuzh/app_reviews @9 eaa 95 f 66364367 e 8752 b 0 f 34 c 00 f 67 aafa 95 d 15 explicitly lists license unknown. Review text stays research-only until rights verified; customer comments are not automatically licensed by repository code.
families.training_implications: Use a rights-cleared real-review corpus, independently label multi-intent topic, bugs and stated churn; retain user star separately as a weak proxy. Add Chinese/code-switched technical questions, complaints, praise, quoted contact requests and explicit nonreply cases.
families.split_unit: Application/shop/product and conversation thread; exact/near-duplicate review grouping before all derived labels.
caveats: Author single run:4.576 s/$0.0225 Jev versus 18.781 s/$0.1576 Gemini 3.8 Flash over public internet; not measured by us.
Jev uses 8.3× input tokens in that harness; output format and list prices explain cost.
Commerce $0 was an OpenCode Zen free gateway promotion; no general free-inference or calibrated-confidence claim follows.

families.title: Dynamic document tags and hierarchical taxonomies

primary_sources.version_note: Rendered documentation readback, not a Git commit; named model/data revisions recorded per family.

families.input_and_task_schema: Article title/body and dynamic tag catalog; one Noul per tag for multilabel selection. Alternative Choice over a flat catalog or Choice per hierarchy node, with beam search; separate ordinal quality rubrics.
families.candidate_and_context_scale: Wagtail clips body to 12,000 characters and chunks tag questions 40/request; quality rubrics 2–10 levels. Janus WoS:145 Domain/area labels, seven parents,500 abstracts, median 1,377 chars. Official cookbook traverses CPC2026.05, Shopify 2026-02, MeSH2026 and cookbook-file trees.
families.harness_and_labels: Wagtail tests are mocked/integration, not semantic gold. Janus commits a 500-sample WoS publication-metadata holdout and 500 examples from official Banking 77 test. WoS archive taxonomies conflict: numeric 134, hierarchy 133, metadata 145. Cookbook uses four worked documents/expected leaves, not a broad benchmark.
families.license_and_ingestion_status: Wagtail and Janus code MIT. Janus reports CC BY4.0 plus an archive notice for WoS; upstream data rights not independently verified here. Taxonomy/document licenses require separate checks. All Janus heldout samples remain evaluation-only.
families.training_implications: Gather independently licensed documents with actual metadata or reviewed tag assignments; include near-synonymous labels, multiple correct branches, sparse labels and no-fit items. Keep metadata labels distinct from adjudicated human labels and train actual text rather than category templates.
families.split_unit: Document/source collection and taxonomy family; hold out entire branches or a separately frozen taxonomy version for transfer tests.
caveats: Wagtail README claims one call regardless tag count, but implementation batches 40.
WoS145-class score cannot be compared to the standard 134-class literature as the same task.
Paper-classification X post reports 1,018 titles+summaries,24 topics,$.08/256 msmedian, but upstream summarization cost$3.99 and accuracy evaluation was still pending.

families.title: Large skill catalog routing with real follow-up context

primary_sources.version_note: Rendered documentation readback, not a Git commit; named model/data revisions recorded per family.

families.input_and_task_schema: User request with a changing skill catalog; wide Choice plus three Noul gates, then top-three Choice with per-skill fit Nouls. The community client passes recent_context="" rather than actual conversation history.
families.candidate_and_context_scale: Community:50–59 skills,240-option chunks, reported APIChoice cap 255; wide~10 k input tokens, two-stage~21.6–25.3 k. Official cookbook:182 skills, short 60-character index, top-three 700-character body excerpts;488 agent requests.
families.harness_and_labels: Community offline harness and six scripted requests onv 0.2.0 report 6/6 sensible. Six real Japanese follow-ups onv 0.1.0 report 3 sensible/3 wrong; no cross-version pooling. Vendor experiment uses jev-1.12 and claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 under a truncated index; not our models or full-description hosts.
families.license_and_ingestion_status: Community code MIT. Each skill body has its own rights; do not assume host skill catalogs or private session logs are redistributable. Cookbook license not separately verified.
families.training_implications: Collect rights-cleared natural task requests and conversational follow-ups, query+history pairs, near-duplicate skill descriptions, oversized catalogs and no-action/none-of-above cases. Test with and without true preceding turns rather than memorizing skill titles.
families.split_unit: Conversation, skill family/repository and catalog version; keep all paraphrases and skill synonyms together.
evaluation_metrics: full two-stage latency and token cost
caveats: Community hook leaves the host full skill roster in context, so no roster-token saving was demonstrated.
Official and community protocols differ in base agent, catalog visibility, model version and language.
Neither returned probability nor fixed.30 gate proves calibration.

families.title: Database model semantics, units and documentation alignment
families.input_and_task_schema: dbt manifest/compiled SQL, model description, upstream schema, sample values and predicates. Choice/Noul/Score inspect column roles, grain, filter intent, semantic units and whether code supports documentation claims.
families.candidate_and_context_scale: 17 question families; subject builder takes at most 12 atomic predicates by default. Header/all comments capped 60/140 lines. Questions share one subject-state; code notes stuffing unrelated subjects together reduces confidence.
families.harness_and_labels: Author field reports discuss a 265-model project and a 357-model warehouse and publishes a per-question verification ledger; reports manual checks on 10 families, two rewritten and five not verified. Unit magnitude initially failed confidently, now language names unit and code checks arithmetic. A prior 213/344 code-contradiction findings unconfirmed; two inspected by author both false despite.95 confidence. Role check 57/61 agreed, three of four disagreements were bad reference labels.
families.license_and_ingestion_status: Apache 2.0 code. Real warehouse schemas/values and public dbt repos retain their own rights; verification prose is not a licensed bulk semantic gold dataset.
families.training_implications: Use original or permissively licensed SQL with executable constraints and independently reviewed meaning. Pair declared docs with actual SQL evidence; deliberately separate absent evidence from contradiction. Label role/unit linguistics independently from deterministic arithmetic and schema checks.
families.split_unit: Warehouse/project plus model lineage; related upstream/downstream SQL and all perturbations grouped.
caveats: A question passing selected probes does not establish precision of a discovery pipeline.
Reported whole-field audits and confidence are not automatically training labels.
Use root-owned SQL converters; this report changes no existing data pipeline.

families.title: SQL relation enrichment and many-row shared-context evaluation
families.input_and_task_schema: A SQL relation supplies(row_id, evidence, questions); mixed Choice/Score/Noul results stream back. Implementation batches distinct inputs and handles nulls, duplicates, query caches and in-flight reuse.
families.candidate_and_context_scale: Author tests batch 1/10/25/100;1,000 unique rows at batch 100/concurrency 10 use 10 requests. Source data derive from 12 nested synthetic support templates. Separate query-cache tests 129 rows.
families.harness_and_labels: Public C++extension and live/replay harnesses; author main run 1,327 requests/7,750 judgments, two 502 retried. Batch equivalence maximum numeric difference.13; repeatedbatch 1 control.10. Generated raw timing/response artifacts are gitignored, report/harness are public.
families.license_and_ingestion_status: Apache 2.0 code. Support fixtures are author templates, not real production labels; use evaluation fixtures only for a benchmark comparison.
families.training_implications: Generalize batching validation using independently sourced real documents with different semantic targets, repeated/near-duplicate IDs, per-row scope markers and conflicting instructions in adjacent rows. This is an evaluation/protocol gap, not a new semantic domain by itself.
families.split_unit: Source document/template first; preserve all derivatives and duplicate groups. Batch assembly must not cross train/test pools.
caveats: Author 1,000 row median.515 s over three repeats includes network/SQL/relay; fixed configuration order is not an isolated causal speedup.
Zero-request warm cache timing is result reuse, not model inference.
Small repeated-template agreement does not establish real-document quality or numerical invariance.

families.title: Closed-loop traffic signal policy
families.input_and_task_schema: City aggregate frame of queues, arrivals, waits, occupancy and hotspots. Choice selects global pressure and switching-hint buckets plus corridor/region priority weights. Deterministic signal controller owns legal phases and minimum green/yellow/all-red.
families.candidate_and_context_scale: State max 48 corridors,64 regions,24 hotspots; default questions cover 8 busiest corridors+6 regions+pressure+hint =at most 16. Pressure and priority each four buckets; switching hint three. No vehicle-level identity.
families.harness_and_labels: Fixed/adaptive/Jev client and headless seeded scenario matrix exist. Default benchmark compares only fixed/adaptive, seeds 42/2026; opt-in liveJev path has caps. No human action labels or independently measured closed-loop Jev score verified.
families.license_and_ingestion_status: No top-level license verified in fetched source; do not import code/assets/maps until reuse terms established. Independent simulator trajectory collection is feasible.
families.training_implications: Generate new simulator maps/seeds and multi-step trajectory supervision from legal controllers/rollout search. Distinguish state-level policy preference from actual travel completion, delay and fairness; evaluate full episodes under model latency and stale observations.
families.split_unit: Map/topology, demand pattern and episode seed; neighboring frames stay in one split.
caveats: The model does not directly set lamps; claiming autonomous signal control without the deterministic controller would misdescribe the demo.
Default benchmark has no Jev calls; repository presence is not evidence of improved traffic flow.

families.title: Chinese tool selection with typed optional arguments
families.input_and_task_schema: Chinese user command; Choice selects four tools ornone; independent conditional Choice questions select service/parameters and Noul says whether each optional argument was stated. Dispatcher reads only the chosen tool and applies defaults in code.
families.candidate_and_context_scale: Source code has four services, argument candidate sets 2–4; total 12 Choice(including tool) +5 Noul =17 questions/request. Four operations: logs, metrics, restart, scale.
families.harness_and_labels: Six-demo suite includes handmade mock probability fixtures and live outputs. Author 28 calls/29,674 input tokens/$0.00125;65 comparisons are mock-versus-model, not independently labeled semantic accuracy. Tool functions form command strings, not execution traces.
families.license_and_ingestion_status: MIT code verified. Keep existing demo requests/mock outputs evaluation-only; no real operational intent corpus.
families.training_implications: Use original Chinese/code-switched requests grounded in rights-cleared real tool schemas. Label missing required arguments, optional defaults, explicit negation and ambiguous target references independently. Include compatible-argument constraints and per-turn outcomes.
families.split_unit: Tool/API family and conversation/task template; hold out catalogs to test dynamic generalization.
evaluation_metrics: complete task success in a sandbox
caveats: Candidate-restricted selection is not unrestricted function-argument generation or a full BFCL score.
Speculative questions must state their conditions; they cannot see the output of the tool-selection question.

families.title: Entity alignment and conservative record linkage

primary_sources.version_note: Rendered documentation readback, not a Git commit; named model/data revisions recorded per family.

families.input_and_task_schema: Two catalog entities with name, manufacturer/brewery, style and numeric attributes. Score 3 selects different/related-review/same; three companion Nouls judge semantic field agreement, arithmetic kept in code.
families.candidate_and_context_scale: Official example 450 Magellan Beer candidate pairs after a first-stage blocker; one pair/request/fourquestions, max workers 6. Vendor modeljev-1.12, reported date 2026-08-11.
families.harness_and_labels: Rendered cookbook includes runnable Python and names candidate_pairs.json/json_cache.json. Binary known_same_as is benchmark gold; middle curator category is a proposed policy, not an independently annotated third class. We did not download benchmark pair/gold files.
families.license_and_ingestion_status: Cookbook and Magellan underlying record redistribution licenses not separately verified. Keep 450 publicbenchmark pairs held out; source license review required for any new record corpus.
families.training_implications: Build independent rights-cleared product/organization records with real identity links, variants, abbreviations, transposed fields and hard negatives. Label three-way ambiguity through review; do not treat binary nonmatch as automatically safe to discard.
families.split_unit: Entity identity and connected candidate-pair graph, not rows; variants/aliases of one identity stay together.
caveats: Rounding an expected ordinal score is a decision policy with implicit boundaries; the cookbook phrase no threshold to fit does not prove calibration.
End-to-end performance must include candidate blocking and review, not only pair classification.

families.input_and_task_schema: Three related document-processing contracts: choose the requested regex span plusnone and semantic attributes; seven Choices read date parts before deterministic calendar resolution; recover stripped formatting by adjacent-line stitch Nouls then block-type Choices and conditional heading/list/callout questions.
families.candidate_and_context_scale: Span worked cases: four email/three phone/four money candidates, plusnone; six country options. Date modeabsolute/relative/none; month/day/year/relativepieces, frozenTODAY2026-07-30. Structure has one question per eligiblelinepair, then three questions/block plus a heading question only for blocks up to 90 characters; six block types and three heading levels(title/section/subsection).
families.harness_and_labels: Rendered code and cached demonstration outputs are available. Structure input is one memo from pinned gist 5 da 03690611 fb 6 ddcbaabdb 91 fb 9 f 91 d 9751 b 113. Date code includes deterministic resolution checks. No independently annotated broad extraction/structure testset was verified.
families.license_and_ingestion_status: Cookbook/gist licensing not separately verified; import no worked-example text. Original documents or permissively licensed structured documents can supply independently constructed training references.
families.training_implications: Derive structure labels from rights-cleared native Markdown/HTML before removing markup; preserve exact source words and split by originaldocument. For extraction use original or permitted documents with role/offset labels and candidate-generation recall. For dates add semantic ambiguity, omitted years, conflicting dates and impossible-calendar cases.
families.split_unit: Originaldocument, sender/template and transformation lineage; semantic variants stay with source. Never generate from cookbook/test examples.
caveats: Fixed candidates guarantee a returned span came from the candidate set, not that it is the right span or that the extractor found every possible answer.
Date convention/normalization and structure renderer are code behavior, not extra neural capabilities.
Official structure headline cost and current price/token code are inconsistent; do not reuse its dollar claim without recomputation.
